desc: 开放式挂耳不入耳，久戴不胀痛，运动稳固可戴眼镜
leaf: 开放式挂耳不入耳气传导蓝牙耳机
name: 开放式挂耳不入耳气传导运动耳机款

shots.intent: 用一秒可读的大字主张把“不入耳也听得自由”这一核心利益点直接压到搜索与详情页首屏。
shots.textZone: top-centered headline zone occupying the upper 45%

shots.intent: 把耳道胀痛、闷堵、压迫这一具体痛点视觉化，让买家在第一眼对号入座。
shots.textZone: one short label band beneath each panel

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入运动场景，确认久戴不累、跑跳不脱落、戴眼镜也不冲突。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline block over the blurred background

shots.intent: 用微距证明无耳塞的隐藏声学单元这一结构主张是真的，解释它不进耳道也能出声。
shots.textZone: single short label with a thin leader line

shots.intent: 把无线连接的稳定性与覆盖范围转成可读信息图，消除断连与延迟顾虑。
shots.textZone: stacked headline block above a two-figure numeric row

shots.intent: 用挂在机身上的水珠实证抗汗抗泼溅，覆盖运动出汗与雨天场景的耐用性疑虑。
shots.textZone: headline over the dark upper band plus one small outlined badge placeholder

shots.intent: 用红勾对灰叉的同框对照，把贴合耳形的轻薄优势变成一眼可判的选择依据。
shots.textZone: one label block per panel beneath each inset

shots.intent: 把续航节奏和规格参数一次说清，替买家完成下单前的最后一步核对。
shots.textZone: three-figure time strip with labels, then a two-column spec card

shots.intent: 用一屏线性图标把全部核心卖点收拢复核，建立结构完整做工可信的品质印象。
shots.textZone: centered title above a six-cell labelled icon grid

shots.intent: 以主图同款机位与配色收口，给出干净的行动入口，让详情页形成闭环。
shots.textZone: upper headline plus one rounded action button on the lower card

style.backgroundSystem: alternating wine-red #6E1015-to-black #0B0B0B gradient hero field, matte cool light-grey #E5E2E0 section band, charcoal #2B2B2B spec card
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight #E4342C line icons with a small solid #E4342C dot and a vertical four-dot pagination motif
style.lightingSystem: soft directional studio key with a controlled specular rim on the product surface, crisp #E4342C glow accents, real grounding contact shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep wine-red #6E1015, pure black #0B0B0B, cool light-grey #E5E2E0 and charcoal panel #2B2B2B, with one signal-red accent #E4342C and one cool tech-blue accent #2F5BEA reserved only for the internal-mechanism screen; cool overall tone; bold modern geometric sans-serif with a two-tone Chinese headline whose key word sits in #E4342C and the remainder in #FFFFFF or #2B2B2B; background system alternating a wine-red #6E1015 to black #0B0B0B gradient hero field, a matte cool light-grey #E5E2E0 section band, and a charcoal #2B2B2B spec card; lighting system of soft directional studio key with a controlled specular rim on the product surface, crisp #E4342C glow accents, and a real grounding contact shadow; icon system of thin single-weight #E4342C line icons plus a small solid #E4342C dot and a vertical pagination-dot motif; layout system of centered stacked headlines, a six-cell icon grid, a three-figure time strip, and paired check-versus-cross comparison panels; product presented at stable scale and centering as an open-ear hook band with a spherical acoustic pod, its colors, material and finish taken verbatim from the reference image and grounded by a real contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no literal brand name, store badge, QR code, or numeric spec text drawn from the source
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and centering, generic open-ear hook band geometry with a spherical acoustic pod, product colors material and finish always taken verbatim from the reference image, never floating without a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: dark lacquered diagonal plane and matte cool light-grey #E5E2E0 counter
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif; two-tone Chinese headline with the keyword in #E4342C and the remainder in #FFFFFF or #2B2B2B; all rendered copy is placeholder-driven
